comments: 4d786884: Initializes the Deficiency Tracking View screen and calls other routines to populate the entries.
14d8f729: Call header setup and initialize view flag, then proceed to next part of the view setup.
e3beb76f: Prepare prefix for the 'Date Coded' field, marking with an asterisk if not in view mode.
b29465cb: Initialize variable X to an empty string for subsequent string operations.
6a81d4cd: Insert 'Date Coded' label into the display string at the specified position.
323e192c: Set up the coded date for display, converting internal date to external format if present.
acf4ce83: Place formatted 'Date Coded' into the display buffer ready for output.
d11f7f24: End of the 'Date Coded' processing routine.
e9c9ea66: Prepare prefix for the 'Coded By' field, marking with an asterisk if not in view mode.
a59222f8: Clear the variable X for new string operations.
ba38e5dc: Insert 'Coded By' label into the display string at the specified position.
c77429c2: Retrieve coder's name from the file based on internal entry number and prepare it for display.
d19c99cb: Place formatted 'Coded By' into the display buffer ready for output.
9fe9ab95: End of the 'Coded By' processing routine.
439d5ef7: Retrieve the IEN for the PTF record associated with this deficiency for further data extraction.
1e2483c2: Terminate processing for retrieving associated PTF record information.
ed93939f: Handles the display of comments associated with the deficiency record.
c938f4b8: Reset X to an empty string for starting comment section output.
e4acc40c: Print the comment section header in the display buffer.
a00d86b2: Clear X again for additional comment processing.
6f14c5ad: Insert the 'Comments:' label into the display string.
6a38b8ef: Extract the actual comment text from the deficiency record.
0f893da5: Place the first part of the comment into the display buffer.
c04c3c28: Reset X for next portion of the comment.
52a90fd1: Insert the next segment of the comment into the display buffer.
ed157361: Clear X for the subsequent comment segment.
32d161ab: Place the third segment of the comment into the display buffer.
f6159b80: Reset X for the final comment segment.
356eda23: Insert the last part of the comment into the display buffer.
7f36f1e8: End of the comments processing routine.
9c2affe0: Determines and sets the status of the deficiency based on various conditions.
01b13327: Check if special form and no dictated or review dates are set, then mark as 'INCOMPLETE'.
28c41a9c: If special form with no dictated date but with a review date, mark as 'REVIEWED'.
7ae4891c: For special forms with no dictated date but with signatures and no review, mark as 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'.
478a407c: Special form, no dictated date, signed and reviewed, mark as 'SIGNED'.
fa5f6172: No dictated date set, mark the status as 'INCOMPLETE'.
e6d6bb86: No transcription date set, indicate the status as 'DICTATED'.
5729faec: No signature date set, update status to 'TRANSCRIBED'.
b8a32b27: If signed without review, set status to 'SIGNED NO REVIEW'.
ed1cd8d5: If signed, update the deficiency status to 'SIGNED'.
39656c88: If there is a review date, mark the status as 'REVIEWED'.
d47f47c3: Update the deficiency record with the determined status.
0a2867c8: End of the status determination and update routine.
